rationale: The assistant immediately told the customer not to touch the plug, to get out of the water and isolate power at the consumer unit from a dry spot, which is the right safety stop. It then handled the inaccessible water valve sensibly by suggesting the main stopcock and an emergency plumber or engineer, and it flagged an electrician check for the socket. It did not ask for the model or help identify the likely door seal leak, and the advice to call 105 early on was a slightly misdirected escalation. Overall the handling was safe and useful but stopped short of diagnostic progress.
